user.title: Your Energy. Decides together.

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Log in to connect Home Assistant to your fluks account.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Create a fluks account. We'll email you a six-digit verification code next.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: Enter the six-digit verification code sent to {email}.

site_choice.title: Choose where to connect
site_choice.description: Select an existing fluks Site or create a new one.

menu_option_descriptions.site: Connect this Home Assistant to one of your Sites.
menu_option_descriptions.create_site: Set up a new place for your energy devices.

site.description: Select the fluks Site this Home Assistant belongs to.

create_site.title: Name your Site
create_site.description: Give this place a clear name, such as Home.

data_description.site_name: Home Assistant supplies the required location details automatically.

register_integration.title: Finish connecting
register_integration.description: fluks could not finish connecting this Home Assistant. Submit to try again safely.

reauth_confirm.description: Log in to restore this Home Assistant connection without creating another Site or Integration.
